text: By mid-morning he had gathered the others in the shaded courtyard of a cheap inn that asked no questions. The air smelled of damp stone, roasting spices, and old beer. A fountain in the center had long since stopped working, though someone had left a small clay cup beside it as if expecting the water to return.
